description: This file defines a Java interface named ErrorResponseAdapterProvider, which provides a method to retrieve an Adapter for a specific ErrorResponse type. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter.provider package and references external classes Adapter and ErrorResponse.

classes.name: ErrorResponseAdapterProvider
classes.description: A generic interface that provides an error response adapter for a specific ErrorResponse type.

methods.name: getErrorResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the error response adapter for the specified ErrorResponse type.
